import os
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    bg=grid[0][0]
    counts={}
    for row in grid:
        vals=[x for x in row if x!=bg]
        if vals:
            c=vals[0]
            counts[c]=counts.get(c,0)+1
    out=[]
    for c in sorted(counts):
        out.append([c]*counts[c])
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
